# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="registry inspect hangar self diff merge run check test build dev debug repl new fmt fix lint explain env trust image os add remove fetch update init clean emit eval bench fuzz version help"
flags="--structural --out --report --repo --json --color --version --emit-rust --check --diff --changed --stdin-path --small --locked --lock -p --annotated --force --message --before --spdx --cyclonedx --advisory-db --vendor-dir --sbom --verbose --online --fix --dry-run --try-anyway --restart --swap --watch --project --pure --freestanding --allow-impure --allow-exec --allow-fs --allow-net --allow-env --allow-io --allow-db --allow-time --allow-rand --allow-log --allow-gpu --target --explain-partition --capabilities-json --update-snapshots --coverage --rust -u --release --profile --a11y --scope --filter --shuffle --serial --iterations --time --seed --corpus"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 2 ]]; then
case "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" in
        registry) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "publish yank keygen key vendor" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        inspect) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "graph query explain-build impact dossier semindex expand schema codemod audit sbom bind logs search info outdated" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        hangar) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "verify repair copy import export dump restore sign rollback generations du" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        self) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "toolchain upgrade doctor completions man devtools lsp" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        os) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "push bridge services config" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        esac
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
